Description - POST /crash

Not verified live. After a crash the Breakpad handler of chomikbox.exe starts crashsender.exe [--no-gui] chomikbox 2.0.8.2 win32 <dump> <message.log> <conf.ini> <uploadQueue.ini> <downloadQueue.ini> <playlist> <hamsterId> <hamsterName>; argv[3], the architecture, is the constant win32. Unless --no-gui is given the user is asked first. crashsender POSTs multipart/form-data (see CrashReportBody) with QNetworkAccessManager; no custom headers besides Content-Type (Qt 4.8.5 adds its defaults, Inferred).

Reply handling (Observed): the reply body, the HTTP status and the headers are never read; only QNetworkReply::error() is checked. On an error the GUI mode shows a box "Error occured" with "Error: <error string>" (only logged with qDebug under --no-gui); there is no success message and no retry, and the process always quits after the first reply or error. Qt 4.8 maps HTTP 4xx/5xx to errors, so any 2xx (and an unfollowed 3xx) counts as success whatever the body says (Inferred). The server's behaviour is Unknown: no report was sent.

Privacy: the report includes conf.ini (login, password MD5, proxy credentials) and message.log.

Request - body and examples

Body required.

Body multipart/form-data

Schema

Schema CrashReportBody: parts in wire order.

Crash report built by crashsender.exe for project chomikbox. Text parts carry Content-Disposition: form-data; name="<n>"; (note the trailing ; ), Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8 and a claimed Content-Transfer-Encoding: quoted-printable although the value is raw UTF-8. File parts use Content-Type: Application/Octet; missing files are skipped. Boundary = a timestamp-based string (CS + date/time in the form ddMMdyyhhmmsszzz). Privacy: conf.ini contains the login, the password MD5 and proxy credentials, and message.log can exceed 100 MB.

  • part project string required = "chomikbox"

    Project name (chomikfile for the sibling product, which sends serverIds/settings instead of the queue files).

  • part version string required

    Client version, 2.0.8.2.

  • part arch string required

    Architecture string passed by the client: the constant win32.

  • part miniDumpFile string · application/octet-stream optional

    Breakpad minidump, filename="minidump-<lower(base name)>.dmp".

  • part messageLogFile string · application/octet-stream optional

    message.log.

  • part confIniFile string · application/octet-stream optional

    conf.ini (contains credentials, see above).

  • part uploadQueueIniFile string · application/octet-stream optional

    uploadQueue.ini.

  • part downloadQueueIniFile string · application/octet-stream optional

    downloadQueue.ini.

  • part playlistFile string · application/octet-stream optional

    playlist.txt.

  • part chomikId string optional

    Account id.

  • part chomikName string optional

    Account name.

  • part checkSum string required

    Lower-case hex MD5 of <project>-<version>.<arch>, i.e. of the constant chomikbox-2.0.8.2.win32 for this build (an integrity tag, no key).

Responses - default

default

Unknown: never observed (no report was sent). crashsender.exe reads neither the body nor the status nor the headers: it checks only the QNetworkReply error code, never retries and quits after the first reply.

Security notes - findings that concern POST /crash

  • C-01 High All client traffic uses plain HTTP (SOAP, upload, resume check, downloads, web login hand-off, updater, crash reports). The SOAP service also answers on HTTPS, but the client never uses it.
  • C-04 High Crash reports upload conf.ini (with the password hash), message.log, both transfer queues, the playlist, chomikId and chomikName over plain HTTP to bts.box.chomikuj.pl:8088; the only integrity value is MD5 of project-version.arch.
  • C-05 Low Verbose logging by default (message.log), which then rides along in crash reports.

From x-security-notes in the spec. Ratings and scope are explained on Security & privacy.
